results.question: 各付款方式的付款總金額
assumptions: Rows of segment 'returns' (transactions that reference an origin transaction are returns; rule and default exclusion confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-09) are excluded by default; say '退貨' to include them.
pos_payment rows are joined to pos_sale through pos_payment.transaction_no; rows without a matching pos_sale row keep NULL there.

paid_amount = Sum of pos_payment.payment_amount. Payments carry no status: every pos_payment row is a completed payment, so 'paid' means every payment. Time is the sale_date of the paid transaction. Signed by the owner on 2026-09-09.
No row filter was applied beyond the time window; every pos_payment row counts, including any status the question did not mention.
No time window was applied; all rows count.
results.sql: SELECT pos_payment.payment_method AS payment_method, SUM(pos_payment.payment_amount) AS paid_amount FROM public.pos_payment LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_payment.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL GROUP BY pos_payment.payment_method ORDER BY payment_method NULLS FIRST
results.interpretation: metric paid_amount over pos_payment; by pos_payment.payment_method
